info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v4-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payouts Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about insurance claims payouts. This endpoint allows users to list and retrieve payout data associated with submitted insurance claims effectively. Typical consumers of this API include insurance adjusters, financial analysts, and claims management systems looking to analyze or report on payout trends and details. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can ensure timely access to essential payout information for decision-making and operational efficiency.
